regime_context: The detector shows a narrowing, non-directional leadership regime in Hong Kong: only 5 of 17 themes are trend-eligible, the leader (Banks) is mean-reverting, crowded and unscorable, and the rotation margin to Energy is thin. The one validated edge (absolute-trend gate) helps on this market's history, so theme selection is a drawdown-avoidance exercise, not a return forecast.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Banks (crowded, mean-revert, trend-gate pass) surrenders its rank-1 leadership to Energy on a closing basis — a confirmed handoff where Energy's score exceeds Banks' score for 5 consecutive sessions would retire this watch.

theses.subject: Energy (H-shares)
theses.thesis: Energy is the only eligible theme with both a trend hurst_tag and non-crowded breadth (0.7), making it the cleanest trend-gate pass in a narrowing eligible set. Its durability_bar is highest among eligible names, so it is the least likely to be shaken out by the validated risk-control leg.
theses.dissent: Energy leadership is thin and may simply be a rebounding low-beta carry trade; the rotation margin to Banks is narrow and the overall absorption (0.45) suggests no strong directional handoff.

falsifier.text: Energy falls below its own 60-day moving average while Banks remains above its own before the check-by date

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable

theses.subject: High-Dividend Blue Chips
theses.thesis: High-Dividend Blue Chips pass the trend gate and are not crowded, with the second-highest durability among eligible names. In a Hong Kong market where the absolute-trend gate is the one validated edge, holding the most trend-persistent uncrowded eligible themes is the discipline-aligned stance.
theses.dissent: The hurst_tag is mixed, not trend, so the theme lacks the clean trending character of Energy; high-dividend names can lag sharply when risk appetite returns to growth sectors.

falsifier.text: High-Dividend Blue Chips trade below their 50-day moving average for 10 consecutive sessions before the check-by date

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable

theses.subject: China Tech & Internet
theses.thesis: China Tech & Internet is deep in the ineligible zone (rank 13, score -0.89), has a mean-revert hurst_tag, and is the only scorable proxy (3033.HK). Since the one validated edge is drawdown avoidance via the trend gate, an ineligible mean-reverting theme is exactly what the discipline says to stand aside from.
theses.dissent: Mean-reverting themes can snap back violently in Hong Kong's policy-driven tape; avoiding it may miss a sharp relief rally if stimulus headlines hit.

falsifier.text: 3033.HK closes above its 60-day average and stays there for 15 sessions before the check-by date
